title: Day 5: Secret Coach

chunks.text: Day five. You voted B... a secret coach. But where do you even find a former pro?
So I asked the street kids. They all pointed at the same guy. The old groundskeeper who sweeps the pitch every night.
They called him Dez. Twelve years as a pro... until his knee gave out.
He rolled me a ball and said two words. "Show me." So I hit him with every step-over I had. He shook his head. "Flashy. Useless."
Then the real training started. Under the lights. Five hundred wall passes... left foot only.
Then the cone weave. Eyes up. Never look at the ball.
Then he made me go one-on-one against him. Bad knee and all. I didn't win the ball once.
At midnight he finally said: "Pros don't do the most tricks. They never waste a touch."
Card check. Passing: twenty-one to twenty-seven. Shooting: nineteen to twenty-two. Overall... twenty-three!
